study: Local oblique structure before an orientation-based recognition intervention
sample_ids: Exactly reuse568 SHA-verified source-only stratified IDs from prior local-echo screen; eight examples per available user/class after existing exclusions. No new sample selection.
image: float64 abs(Hilbert(realRF,range)); average contiguous3range bins to63; sqrt(image/per-clip/per-radar maximum). Zero remainszero; no learned normalization.
tensor: 2D Sobel time/range /8; Gaussian sigma2pixels,truncate4,reflect over gradient products gt²,gt*gr,gr². No smoothing across sample/view axes.
control: One sampleID-seeded permutation of90frames, shared acrossviews, applied before gradients; no label permutation. Preserves per-frame range profiles but destroys ordinary temporal locality.
eligibility: Trace>=75th percentile of original sampled-grid trace and>1e-12; same threshold in original/shuffled; separate eligible denominators, reportcoverage.
obliqueness: 2abs(b)/sqrt((a-d)^2+4b²)>=.3; normal/tangent direction must be away from axes; coordinate dependent, not calibrated velocity.
aggregation: Usable/eligible withinclip (empty0), equalclip per user/radar. Engineering feasibility thresholds, not significance.
cost: First two existing source IDs,2x total-extraction estimate, no quality metrics printed; after protocol remote push/readback.
if_fail: Stop this tensor/preprocessing/grid/threshold configuration without adaptive scale/gate/seed search or CNN training.
if_pass: Only supports a separately preregistered recognition test against equal-capacity nonorientation controls and strongCNN. Not success or innovation.
limitations: Existing reused source users, not held/test/generalization evidence
Dominant local texture direction is not correspondence or hand velocity; interference and amplitude changes also produce streaks
Time permutation changes temporal spectrum and eligibility; not isolated physical intervention
Fixed image-coordinate scale and nonlinear contrast normalization; no all-scale/true-speed invariance
HOG/structure tensors established prior art; no original contribution claimed
No classifier/parameter fitting and no user1/2 signals accessed
